scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Ladies and Gentlemen! ! !
You've heard rumors but you've never once seen with your own eyes
the world's rarest diamond!
The ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 is currently on sale for a cheap price!!
If valuable diamonds interest you then listen up!
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
女士们，先生们！！！
你们一定听过传闻，却还没亲眼见过这世上最稀有的钻石吧！
^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000正在超值出售！！
对珍贵钻石感兴趣的朋友，请听我说！

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
You can give the diamond as a gift to your lover.
The receiver of the ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 will cherish it
and treasure you in their heart.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
您可以把钻石作为礼物送给爱人。
收到^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000的人一定会倍加珍惜，也会将您珍藏在心中。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
What? You don't have a lover?
You can still just hang on to it for yourself.
The enchanting aura of the ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 is likely
to bring love into your life.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
什么？您没有爱人？
那就自己留着吧。
^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000的迷人光彩，说不定能为您招来爱情。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Known as the captivating diamond of diamonds...
It is the ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000!
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
它被称为钻石中的钻石...
它就是^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000！

scripts.text: ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000?
Exchange my 17 Carat Diamond for zeny...
scripts.translation: 把我的17克拉钻石兑换成Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Yes!
Hehe, the ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 you see right now
is one of the highest quality 17 carat diamonds.
Comparing it to any pea-sized, colorless rock you may have
dug up from Morocc is unspeakable!
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
没错！嘿嘿，您眼前这颗^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000，可是17克拉钻石中的极品。
在梦罗克挖到的那些豌豆大小的透明石头，怎么能跟它比！

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Some claim that this is the very same diamond
that was seen by Kachua in Comodo!
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
有人说，这就是卡楚阿在克魔岛见过的那颗钻石！

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: How much is it?
scripts.translation: 多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
It's rather inexpensive!
If you're interested, talk to me any time!
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
相当便宜！
如果您感兴趣，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Of course! The most important thing is price!
As I've said earlier, the ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 has been
appraised as a 17 carat diamond.
There aren't many like it in the world.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
当然，最重要的是价格！
正如我刚才所说，这颗^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000可是经过鉴定的17克拉钻石。
这样的钻石，世上可没几颗。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
The price is a mere 500 million zeny!
There is also a 1,000,000z service fee.
Compared to the quality of the diamond
this is a small price to pay.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
只要5亿Zeny！
另外收取1,000,000 Zeny的服务费。
以这颗钻石的品质来说，这点钱算得了什么。

scripts.text: ^828282It's too expensive.^000000
I'll buy it.
scripts.translation: 我要买

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
To say that a diamond such as the
^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 is too expensive, 
you leave me speechless.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
像^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000这样的钻石，您居然还嫌贵，我真不知道该说什么了。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
OOOH! I knew from the moment I saw you that you were the rightful
owner of this wonderful diamond.
I'm glad I wasn't wrong!
I believe this diamond will suit you quite well.
All I need from you is to complete this contract.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
噢！从见到您的那一刻起，我就知道您才是这颗钻石真正的主人。
太好了，我果然没看错！
我相信这颗钻石与您再相配不过。
只要请您签下这份契约就行。

scripts.text: ^B9062FI will sign the contract.^000000
^828282Nevermind, I changed my mind.^000000

[Rare Diamond Merchant]
I see, that's too bad..
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
好吧，那真是太遗憾了...

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
您叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Alright then, please sign here.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
好的，请在这里签字。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Okay, good.
All that is left now is payment.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
好的，很好。
现在只剩下付款了。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
. . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
...

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Calculating the price and service fee..
501,000,000 zeny.
Amount has been confirmed.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
正在计算价格和服务费...
501,000,000 Zeny。
金额已确认。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
You may exchange the diamond back for zeny at any time.
However, there will be a 1,000,000z service fee.
Thank you for your business.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
您可以随时将钻石兑换回Zeny。
不过，需要支付1,000,000 Zeny的服务费。
感谢您的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Hm?
I'm sorry, but you don't have sufficient funds.
Including the service fee, a total of 501,000,000z is required.
Please check your zeny balance and try again.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
嗯？
很抱歉，您的资金不足。
加上服务费，总共需要501,000,000 Zeny。
请检查您的Zeny余额后重试。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Is this really your signature?
Will sign again to confirm?
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
这真的是您的签名吗？
需要重新签名以确认吗？

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
AAH. You would like to exchange your ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000 for zeny?
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
啊。您想要将^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000兑换成Zeny吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Then, what is it you desire?..
. . . . . ....
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
那您到底想要什么呢？
...

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
I see. After I receive your signature, 
You must offer your ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000.
Also don't forget there is a 1,000,000z service fee!
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
明白了。
签字后，请交给我您的^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000。
别忘了还有1,000,000 Zeny的服务费！

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
您叫什么名字？

[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Alright then, please sign here.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
好的，请在这里签字。

scripts.text: Sign
scripts.translation: 签字

scripts.text: Don't Sign
scripts.translation: 不签字

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
The trade cannot be completed without your signature.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
没有您的签名，交易无法完成。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Your signature has been received.
I will now take your ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000..
You will receive ^0000FF499,000,000z^000000 afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
已收到您的签名。
我现在将收取您的^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000...
之后您将收到^0000FF499,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Thank you for your business.
Whenever you need a ^FF82FF'17 Carat Diamond'^000000,
come back anytime with 500 million zeny.
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
感谢您的惠顾。
想再买^FF82FF“17克拉钻石”^000000的话，随时带着5亿Zeny来找我。

scripts.text:
[Rare Diamond Merchant]
Is this really your signature?
Will sign again to confirm?
scripts.translation:
[稀有钻石商人]
这真的是您的签名吗？
需要重新签名以确认吗？
